hints.title: Sequential Comparison
hints.text: Compare the characters of string s and string t sequentially from the start.

hints.title: Single Character Skip Handling
hints.text: When a mismatch occurs, skip at most one character from s while keeping the position in t unchanged.

hints.title: Prefix Termination Invariant
hints.text: If a second mismatch occurs after already skipping one character, no further extension is possible.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Linear scan using two pointers with at most one character skip.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all single-character deletions takes O(n^2) time and memory.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Advancing pointers greedily on match and consuming the single skip on mismatch solves the prefix problem directly.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use two pointers with a boolean flag to track whether a character skip has occurred.
